🔥🇲🇽 <u>Samuel García reported to the FGR for organized crime</u>

Morena's Nuevo León coordinator Clara Luz Flores, joined by Senator Alejandro Murat and Deputy Alfonso Ramírez Cuéllar, filed a criminal complaint with the FGR against Governor Samuel García, his wife Mariana Rodríguez and his father for organized crime, embezzlement, illicit enrichment and money laundering. The core accusation is that more than 7 billion pesos in public money went through a network of companies tied to a law firm in the governor's family circle. Monterrey's PRI mayor Adrián de la Garza is also named. Across both administrations, more than 14 billion pesos in public funds are at stake.

🇲🇽📈 <u>INEGI: 18 straight months of upward signals for Mexico's economy</u>

INEGI's leading indicator reached 100.8 points in September, above its long-term trend and rising for an 18th consecutive month, which points to growth continuing into 2027. The coincident indicator was at 100.2 in August, also above trend. The recession the opposition keeps forecasting still hasn't shown up.

🇲🇽💵 <u>Peso gains 27 centavos as Trump loses Congress</u>

The peso closed Wednesday at 18.5669 per dollar, up 27.16 centavos (1.44%) from Tuesday's 18.8385, according to Banxico data, after Democrats took the House and, unexpectedly, the Senate. Banco Base says the dollar suffered its worst intraday fall since August 19.

🇲🇽☀️ <u>Tlaxcala: free solar power for 1,215 homes</u>

Governor Lorena Cuéllar's "Energía para tu Vivienda" program has now installed 1,215 photovoltaic systems in homes without electric service, and families pay nothing. In 2026 alone, 314 systems went to households in 41 municipalities, benefiting 1,325 people. Cumulative investment is above 62.4 million pesos.

🇲🇽📱 <u>Screen addiction is hitting Mexican kids' mental health</u>

INEGI's ENDUTIH 2025 counts 103.2 million cellphone users in Mexico, 84.6% of everyone aged six and up and 26.8 million more than in 2015. Of smartphone users, 80.4% are on social media. Daily internet time rose from 3.2 to 4.4 hours between 2017 and 2024, and 18-to-24-year-olds average 5.7. Specialists consulted by Contralínea link problematic use to anxiety, depression and lost sleep, the backdrop to the SEP's school phone restriction that took effect this week.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum: Ugalde was the "executor" of the 2006 fraud</u>

Luis Carlos Ugalde, IFE president from 2003 to 2007, now wants a "consensus" pick for INE's new president. Sheinbaum pointed to his own memoir, Así lo viví, where he admits the PRI named him on Elba Esther Gordillo's recommendation. She also cited Fox's recent admission that he fostered the fraud that put Calderón in office. "What moral authority does Ugalde have to speak about democracy? None."

🇲🇽🩺 <u>More medical school seats at Bienestar and Rosario Castellanos universities</u>

Asked about doctor shortages in Sinaloa and Michoacán, Sheinbaum said the government will keep opening medicine and nursing schools at the Benito Juárez Bienestar universities and the Rosario Castellanos National University. Their graduates already work at IMSS and ISSSTE, and students do hospital practice from year two. The Health University in CDMX alone takes 2,000 students from across the country. "It is a need of the country, it is a demand."

🔥🇲🇽 <u>UIF freezes accounts of 40 INE-linked people and firms</u>

Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit froze the accounts of 25 people and 15 companies tied to suppliers of the National Electoral Institute, and filed complaints with the FGR. The probe covers rigged tenders, conflicts of interest and simulated competition between bidders, the same "duopoly" that has printed Mexico's electoral materials for two decades. El Universal reports that ex-INE chief Guadalupe Taddei and supplier Hernández Casillas are on the list.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Record: Mexico Ships $62.2 Billion to the US in One Month</u>

Mexican exports to the US hit an all-time high of $62.2 billion in September, up 40% from a year earlier and the fifth straight month of growth, per US Census data reported by El Financiero. Mexico supplied 17.6% of all US imports, ahead of Canada (9.9%) and China (8.9%). 83% of those goods entered under T-MEC preferences, so they paid none of Trump's tariffs. Mexico's surplus with the US for the year so far stands at $184 billion.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Plan Michoacán Turns One: 72 Billion Pesos In</u>

One year after it launched, Plan Michoacán has 1,680 actions completed, is 67% done and has more than 72.43 billion pesos invested. The IMSS has given 2.5 million vaccines and 502,000 consultations and is building two hospitals. The ISSSTE added 33 clinics, and the Housing for Well-being program is putting nearly 12 billion pesos toward 82,000 homes. "We must keep working to move forward and achieve peace and security," Sheinbaum said.
